results.recap: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov, known for his vicious and foolish nature, rose from nothing to acquire a considerable fortune and led a chaotic family life. He married twice; first to Adelaïda Ivanovna Miüsov, who eloped with him and bore him a son, Dmitri, before eventually leaving him. Fyodor abandoned the young Dmitri, who was subsequently raised by the servant Grigory and later passed between various relatives. Dmitri grew up wild, expecting an inheritance that dwindled due to Fyodor's crafty dealings, leaving him bitter and overwhelmed when he discovered his financial ruin. Fyodor's second marriage to the meek Sofya Ivanovna brought two more sons, Ivan and Alexey, who were also abandoned after her death but raised by the generous intervention of the general's widow and Yefim Petrovitch Polenov. Ivan became a clever and self-reliant student, while Alexey, or Alyosha, was drawn to monastic life under the influence of the gentle elder Zossima, who he reverently served.
